_comment: Economy tuning for War of Love — data-driven so prices can be rebalanced without code changes (loaded by GameData -> ContinueOffers). `extra_moves` tiers are the in-level 'Need More Moves?' continue options: `moves` is added straight to the running level, `cost` is spent through the existing coin Economy/SaveService. NO second currency, NO second save. Booster prices themselves live in data/boosters.json.
